scope: FEAT-028–030, ADR-004, CONTRACT-067–069, SD-028–030, US/TD/STP-080–085 and affected governing documents

rounds.verdict: Sound architectural direction; seven actionable contract corrections required before implementation handoff.
rounds.additionalSuggestion: Precisely specify canonical JSON serialization and independent digest vectors.

rounds.verdict: All seven original findings substantively resolved; no remaining P1. Two bounded clarifications remain.

rounds.qualification: Draft ready for independent second opinion and recorded qualification gates; not implementation/native adoption readiness.
rounds.conclusion: Verified both corrected paragraphs. Nested carriers, array/map absence, Patch null policy, and KEY_IDENTITY.inputDigest are now explicit and consistent. Hashing and DTO equality are appropriately separated from UMF key semantics.
rounds.closure: Review closed: no unresolved findings from this review.

findings.issue: Core availability/default declarations did not define omission/null carriers or default execution.
findings.correction: Complete explicit valueBindings; preserve-only default policy; pre-default versus stored-row validity separated; FR52/PY02/AC1 and tests aligned.

findings.issue: Bare aliases could collapse module-qualified Fields.
findings.correction: 0.1 refuses equal bare IDs across qualified membership, including aliases, nested records and projections; explicit counterexample allocated.

findings.issue: Raw Spark TimestampType naive local datetime conflicts with aware instant admission.
findings.correction: Explicit exact epoch-microsecond text transport; raw datetime refuses; process/session timezone, negative epoch, DST and precision controls allocated.

findings.issue: Backend schema/configuration admission and codec signatures were underspecified.
findings.correction: Exact passive schema observation and SchemaMatch, ordered metadata and named/full-row decoders; driver transport explicitly separately qualified; no authorization inferred.

findings.issue: Valid Python identifiers may be private Pydantic fields or shadow imports.
findings.correction: Target-aware public field/package restrictions and complete reserved/imported sets; static/runtime negative fixtures allocated.

findings.issue: Generated key identity/encoding claims lacked a public boundary.
findings.correction: Explicit immutable qualified KEY_IDENTITY, no generated UMF encoder/equality API, disabled key hashing, existing qualified consumer codec retained; golden-vector adoption requirement.

findings.issue: Primary Python gate omitted static-negative harness.
findings.correction: STP-081 runs test_static.py and requires intended diagnostics with valid imports.

findings.issue: Nested primitive carriers and Patch null relation needed explicit policy.
findings.correction: Reached item/value bindings, exact native/profile carrier rules or refusal, no array omission/UNSET, absent map key separate from null, Patch null equals create.null in 0.1 or refuses.

findings.issue: Key identity prose mentioned an unlisted digest.

additionalCorrection: RFC8785 JCS defines exact canonical bytes; shared Unicode/number/digest controls allocated.
limitations: Model review is design evidence, not implementation correctness or native qualification.
No consumer contract was adopted or overwritten.
Exact dependency locks, native/managed evidence, consumer-local scope choices and implementation authorization remain future gates.
